column1: # Source files for tools/fwsrc.py: `start end name [evidence]`. The range [start, end)
# becomes <name>.s, in its own section .text.<name>; the linker keeps stock order. Ranges
# left out become gap_<start>.s. A range must start on a layout unit, and only wide
# branches (bl, b.w) and data words may refer across files.
# Only ranges with evidence for their extent: the image has no source file names.
0800c000 0800c1ac vectors                vector table: 107 words up to the image header
0800c1ac 0800c1d0 image_header           "MAIN" + BCD version, read by the bootloader (sysex-handlers.md)
08023a78 08024070 stm32f4xx_it           IRQ and fault handlers in ST's stm32f4xx_it.c order, reversed (NMI_Handler last)
08025ebc 08025ec0 libstdcxx_new_opv      operator new[]: b.w operator new
08025ec0 08025ee0 libstdcxx_new_op       operator new: malloc, retried through the new handler
08026768 080267a0 libc_memmove           byte loops, backwards on overlap
08026d94 0802ae30 rodata                 app constant data after the library code (D_08026d94 is read by app code): session_defaults, vtables, tables, strings
0802ae30 0802ae34 rodata_libc_impure     _global_impure_ptr -> impure_data (0x20000BB4); its "C" (0x0802AE2D) stays in rodata, strings are merged
0802ae94 0802aec8 rodata_libc_vfprintf   "#-0+ ", "hlL", "efgEFG" (_vfprintf_r), hex digits (_printf_i); one file: strings end unaligned
0802aeec 0802baa0 data                   app .data load image: Reset_Handler copies 0x0802AEEC-0x0802BB04 to 0x20000000-0x20000C18
0802baa0 0802bb04 data_libc_impure       impure_data (0x20000BB4: fake stdin/stdout/stderr, locale "C") and _impure_ptr (0x20000C14)
0802bb04 0802bb20 image_tail             28 bytes past .data (8 x ff, then zeros) up to the image end; unknown
